test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Articles of the Indian Constitution deal with the Union Executive?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Articles 52 to 78__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**__Articles 52 to 78__

__
 
• **Articles 52 to 78 of the Indian Constitution deal with the Union Executive**.

 
 
• **Article 52 **states that **there shall be a President of India.**
 
• **Article 53** talks about that the **executive power of the Union shall be vested in the President **and shall be exercised by him.
 
• **Article 56** defines the** term of the office of the President to be of five years **
 
• **Article 58** talks about the **eligibility of a person to become President of India.**
 
• **Article 59** of the Indian Constitution talks about the **conditions of the President’s office.**
 
• **Article 71** deals with **matters relating to the election of the President.**
 
• **Article 72 **provides for the provisions relating to the pardoning powers of the President.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 38** talks about **Social, Political, and Economic Justice. **
 
• **Article 39** mentions all the** Principles of policy that must be followed by the State.**
 
• **Article 40 **deals with the **Organization of Panchayats.**
 
• **Article 41** talks about **Welfare Government. **
 
• **Article 42 **talks about **Securing just and humane work and maternity relief.**
 
• **Article 43 **talks about **Fair wages and a decent standard of life**. 
 
• **Article 44** talks about the **Uniform Civil Code.**
 
• **Article 45** contains the Provision for** free and compulsory education for the children** in the country.
 
• **Article 46 **deals with the **Protection of SCs, STs, and weaker sections **from exploitation.
 
• **Article 47** talks about **Nutrition, Standard of living, and public health.**
 
• **Article 48** talks about **Scientific agriculture and animal husbandry. **
 
• **Article 49 **talks about the **Protection of monuments and places and objects of national importance. **
 
• **Article 50** talks about the **Separation of the Judiciary from the Executive.**
